message: トラウマ仕掛け人
I try to think about the factors behind Kirafes's success.
Of course, it's because everyone in the Student Council and the people of Ryuusei Town, starting with the Shiokumi Shopping District, helped us out.
However, when it comes to the most fundamental part... I think it's thanks to Helena-san correcting our course right at the very beginning.
As the student council president, I want to say a word of thanks.

name: Helena
message: 「Come in」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I know that」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, if you're here to say thanks, don't worry about it\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, I'd feel bad sending a boy away empty-handed when he came all this way just to properly say thank you」

name: Helena
message: 「So, Synn-chan, you're going to help me with an experiment, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Are you researching something?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, of course! About my cute little sister. Boop♪」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Did you just press some weird button?」

name: Helena
message: 「Foh-foh-foh-foh」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is this falling sound?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhooh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's dark!」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, it smells like pumpkin」

name: Helena
message: 「A huge success!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is it this time!? I hear a sound like a fishing rod reeling in?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's because I am reeling in a fishing rod」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a surreal conversation」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah, hah, hah, my vision's back... W-What the heck was that just now?」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, you're so calm, Synn-chan. Being a chairwoman is boring, sure, but I'm also reliable, you know」

name: Helena
message: 「By the way, did you bump your head or anything? Does your neck hurt?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, I'm fine. I was startled when everything suddenly went pitch black, though. Doesn't look like I need to worry about whiplash either」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, you'd better step aside for now, yeah? Look up」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena-san... there's a giant jack-o'-lantern swaying right above my head, isn't there?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's Halloween today, after all. I made that myself. It's hung on a string so I can move it around freely」

name: Paqy
message: 「That creepy pumpkin monster is what just dropped right onto Master Synn's noggin」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, you're really handy, Helena-san」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, I used to make tons of them for Ria when we were kids」

name: Synn
message: 「Having sisters sounds nice, it's really heartwarming」

name: Helena
message: 「Ria was terrible with jack-o'-lanterns, you see--she'd shriek and cry and run around trying to get away」

name: Helena
message: 「Not making any jack-o'-lanterns at the Kujou house for the past few years was all a scheme to lower Ria's guard」

name: Helena
message: 「Tonight, once Ria falls asleep, I'll rig the lantern to float up eerily in the corner of her bedroom ceiling」

name: Helena
message: 「And then, aiming straight for Ria's trembling, terrified little face, the lantern will drop right over her head, just like it did to you earlier, Synn-chan♪」

name: Helena
message: 「This plan is pure perfection!!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... back when she was a kid is one thing, but do you think that'll work on Ria-senpai now that she's all grown up and dignified?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? Truth is, Ria is still terrified of ghosts even now♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so」

name: Helena
message: 「Once it succeeds, you'll be the very first person I contact, Synn-chan. Wait for the good news, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right...」
And then, late at night, the phone at Grand Palace Sakura rang out, and on the other end of the line, Helena began a live play-by-play.
